long_biography.plain_text:
Betsy Schraad serves on the board of Automobile Alley, an Oklahoma City association concerned with the district's promotion and street-level improvements. Her public community involvement also includes gifts with her husband, Bill, to medical research and Oklahoma State athletics. The couple's giving has been recognised alongside Schraad Enterprises.

Bill is the second-generation head of Schraad Sales & Marketing, a food-brokerage and consumer-brand agency founded by his father. Elizabeth Schraad has handled administration connected to the family business, including employee benefit arrangements. Beyond these activities, she has kept much of her working life private.
